+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import math
+import avelang
+import avelang.language as al
+
+# ── ConvTranspose2d tiling constants ──────────────────────────────────────────
+TILE_H = 16
+TILE_W = 16
+C_OUT_TILE = 8
+C_IN_TILE = 8
+C_TOTAL = 64
+KERNEL = 3
+THREADS_CONV = 256
+IN_H = 256
+IN_W = 256
+OUT_H = IN_H + KERNEL - 1  # 258
+OUT_W = IN_W + KERNEL - 1  # 258
+
+SPATIAL_TILES_H = (OUT_H + TILE_H - 1) // TILE_H  # 17
+SPATIAL_TILES_W = (OUT_W + TILE_W - 1) // TILE_W  # 17
+SPATIAL_TILES = SPATIAL_TILES_H * SPATIAL_TILES_W  # 289
+C_OUT_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_OUT_TILE  # 8
+C_IN_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_IN_TILE  # 8
+
+PAD = KERNEL - 1  # 2
+IN_TILE_H = TILE_H + PAD  # 18
+IN_TILE_W = TILE_W + PAD  # 18
+IN_TILE_ELEMS = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE  # 2592
+WT_ELEMS = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL  # 576
+
+BF16_BYTES = 2
+
+# ── GroupNorm constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+NUM_GROUPS = 8
+C_PER_GROUP = C_TOTAL // NUM_GROUPS  # 8
+GN_N = C_PER_GROUP * OUT_H * OUT_W  # 8 * 258 * 258 = 532512
+GN_BLOCK_SIZE = 256
+GN_TILE_SIZE = 4096
+GN_NUM_TILES = (GN_N + GN_TILE_SIZE - 1) // GN_TILE_SIZE  # 131
+
+
+# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+# ConvTranspose2d + GELU fused kernel
+# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+
+@avelang.jit
+def _load_input_to_shm(
+    shm_in: al.Tensor((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16),
+    x_rsrc: al.Tensor((4,), al.u32),
+    n: al.u32,
+    cin_base: al.u32,
+    tile_h_start: al.u32,
+    tile_w_start: al.u32,
+    tid: al.u32,
+):
+    zero = al.convert(0, al.u32)
+    total = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE
+    idx = tid
+    for _ in al.range((total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV):
+        if idx < total:
+            c = idx % C_IN_TILE
+            s = idx // C_IN_TILE
+            ih = s // IN_TILE_W
+            iw = s - ih * IN_TILE_W
+            src_h = tile_h_start + ih - PAD
+            src_w = tile_w_start + iw - PAD
+            valid = al.convert(1, al.u32)
+            if src_h >= IN_H:
+                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
+            if src_w >= IN_W:
+                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
+            off = (n * C_TOTAL * IN_H * IN_W + (cin_base + c) * IN_H * IN_W + src_h * IN_W + src_w) * BF16_BYTES
+            val_u32 = al.amdgpu.raw_buffer_load_x1(x_rsrc, zero, off, 0)
+            if valid != 0:
+                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.bitcast(val_u32, al.bf16)
+            else:
+                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.convert(0.0, al.bf16)
+        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV
+
+
+@avelang.jit
+def _load_weight_to_shm(
+    shm_wt: al.Tensor((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16),
+    wt_rsrc: al.Tensor((4,), al.u32),
+    cout_base: al.u32,
+    cin_base: al.u32,
+    tid: al.u32,
+):
+    zero = al.convert(0, al.u32)
+    total = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
+    idx = tid
+    for _ in al.range((total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV):
+        if idx < total:
+            cout_idx = idx // (C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL)
+            rest = idx - cout_idx * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
+            cin_idx = rest // (KERNEL * KERNEL)
+            rest2 = rest - cin_idx * KERNEL * KERNEL
+            kh = rest2 // KERNEL
+            kw = rest2 - kh * KERNEL
+            # weight layout: (in_channels, out_channels, K, K) = (C_TOTAL, C_TOTAL, 3, 3)
+            # weight[cin_global, cout_global, kh, kw]
+            cin_global = cin_base + cin_idx
+            cout_global = cout_base + cout_idx
+            off = (cin_global * C_TOTAL * KERNEL * KERNEL + cout_global * KERNEL * KERNEL + kh * KERNEL + kw) * BF16_BYTES
+            val_u32 = al.amdgpu.raw_buffer_load_x1(wt_rsrc, zero, off, 0)
+            shm_wt[cout_idx, cin_idx, kh, kw] = al.bitcast(val_u32, al.bf16)
+        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV
+
+
+@avelang.jit
+def conv_transpose_gelu_kernel(
+    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
+    wt_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
+    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
+    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
+    batch_size: al.u32,
+):
+    tid = al.thread_id(0)
+    bid_x = al.block_id(0)   # spatial tile index
+    bid_y = al.block_id(1)   # batch * c_out_tile index
+
+    n = bid_y // C_OUT_TILES
+    cout_tile = bid_y - n * C_OUT_TILES
+    cout_base = cout_tile * C_OUT_TILE
+
+    tile_h_idx = bid_x // SPATIAL_TILES_W
+    tile_w_idx = bid_x - tile_h_idx * SPATIAL_TILES_W
+    tile_h_start = tile_h_idx * TILE_H
+    tile_w_start = tile_w_idx * TILE_W
+
+    x_memref = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((batch_size * C_TOTAL * IN_H * IN_W,), (1,)))
+    wt_memref = al.make_tensor(wt_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((C_TOTAL * C_TOTAL * KERNEL * KERNEL,), (1,)))
+    bias_memref = al.make_tensor(bias_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((C_TOTAL,), (1,)))
+    out_memref = al.make_tensor(out_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((batch_size * C_TOTAL * OUT_H * OUT_W,), (1,)))
+
+    x_rsrc = al.amdgpu.make_rsrc(x_memref, batch_size * C_TOTAL * IN_H * IN_W * BF16_BYTES)
+    wt_rsrc = al.amdgpu.make_rsrc(wt_memref, C_TOTAL * C_TOTAL * KERNEL * KERNEL * BF16_BYTES)
+
+    shm_in = al.make_shared((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16)
+    shm_wt = al.make_shared((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16)
+
+    # Accumulators: one f32 per output position assigned to this thread
+    ACC_PER_THREAD = (TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
+    acc = al.make_local((ACC_PER_THREAD,), al.f32)
+    for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
+        acc[i] = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
+
+    # Preload weight tile - same for all cin iterations
+    _load_weight_to_shm(shm_wt, wt_rsrc, cout_base, al.convert(0, al.u32), tid)
+
+    # Iterate over input channel tiles
+    for cin_tile in al.range(C_IN_TILES):
+        cin_base = cin_tile * C_IN_TILE
+        _load_input_to_shm(shm_in, x_rsrc, n, cin_base, tile_h_start, tile_w_start, tid)
+        al.syncthreads()
+
+        _load_weight_to_shm(shm_wt, wt_rsrc, cout_base, cin_base, tid)
+        al.syncthreads()
+
+        # Each thread computes its assigned output elements
+        for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
+            idx = tid * ACC_PER_THREAD + i
+            if idx < TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE:
+                local_cout = idx % C_OUT_TILE
+                s = idx // C_OUT_TILE
+                local_h = s // TILE_W
+                local_w = s - local_h * TILE_W
+
+                sum_val = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
+                for cin_idx in al.range(C_IN_TILE):
+                    for kh in al.range(KERNEL):
+                        for kw in al.range(KERNEL):
+                            in_h = local_h + PAD - kh
+                            in_w = local_w + PAD - kw
+                            in_val = al.convert(shm_in[in_h, in_w, cin_idx], al.f32)
+                            wt_val = al.convert(shm_wt[local_cout, cin_idx, kh, kw], al.f32)
+                            sum_val = sum_val + in_val * wt_val
+                acc[i] = acc[i] + sum_val
+
+        al.syncthreads()
+
+    # Apply bias, GELU, and write output
+    sqrt_two_over_pi = al.convert(0.7978845608028654, al.f32)  # sqrt(2/pi)
+    gelu_coeff = al.convert(0.044715, al.f32)
+    half = al.convert(0.5, al.f32)
+    one = al.convert(1.0, al.f32)
+
+    for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
+        idx = tid * ACC_PER_THREAD + i
+        if idx < TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE:
+            local_cout = idx % C_OUT_TILE
+            s = idx // C_OUT_TILE
+            local_h = s // TILE_W
+            local_w = s - local_h * TILE_W
+
+            global_h = tile_h_start + local_h
+            global_w = tile_w_start + local_w
+            global_cout = cout_base + local_cout
+
+            if global_h < OUT_H and global_w < OUT_W:
+                val = acc[i]
+                # Add bias
+                b = al.convert(bias_memref[global_cout], al.f32)
+                val = val + b
+                # GELU: 0.5 * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(2/pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x^3)))
+                x3 = val * val * val
+                inner = sqrt_two_over_pi * (val + gelu_coeff * x3)
+                gelu_out = half * val * (one + al.tanh(inner))
+                # Write output
+                out_idx = (n * C_TOTAL * OUT_H * OUT_W + global_cout * OUT_H * OUT_W + global_h * OUT_W + global_w)
+                out_memref[out_idx] = al.convert(gelu_out, al.bf16)
+
+
+# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+# GroupNorm multi-pass kernels
+# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+
+@avelang.jit
+def groupnorm_reduce_kernel(
+    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
+    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
+    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
+    batch_size: al.u32,
+    num_tiles: al.u32,
+):
+    """
+    Phase 1: reduce each tile into (sum, sum_sq) for each (batch, group) pair.
+    Grid: (num_tiles, batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, 1), Block: (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1)
+    """
+    tid = al.thread_id(0)
+    bid_x = al.block_id(0)  # tile index
+    bid_y = al.block_id(1)  # batch * num_groups index
+
+    batch_idx = bid_y // NUM_GROUPS
+    group_idx = bid_y - batch_idx * NUM_GROUPS
+    tile_idx = bid_x
+
+    if batch_idx < batch_size:
+        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
+        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
+
+        group_c_start = group_idx * C_PER_GROUP
+
+        tile_start = tile_idx * GN_TILE_SIZE
+        tile_end = tile_start + GN_TILE_SIZE
+        if tile_end > GN_N:
+            tile_end = GN_N
+
+        layout_in = al.make_layout((batch_size * C_TOTAL * OUT_H * OUT_W,), (1,))
+        x = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, layout_in)
+
+        local_sum = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
+        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
+
+        # Map linear index within group to global linear index
+        # Linear index within group: tile_start + tid + stride
+        for li in al.range(tile_start + tid, tile_end, GN_BLOCK_SIZE):
+            # Convert linear group index to (c_in_group, h, w)
+            c_g = li // (OUT_H * OUT_W)
+            rest = li - c_g * OUT_H * OUT_W
+            h = rest // OUT_W
+            w = rest - h * OUT_W
+
+            global_c = group_c_start + c_g
+            global_idx = batch_idx * C_TOTAL * OUT_H * OUT_W + global_c * OUT_H * OUT_W + h * OUT_W + w
+            val = al.convert(x[global_idx], al.f32)
+            local_sum = local_sum + val
+            local_sq = local_sq + val * val
+
+        smem_sum[tid] = local_sum
+        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
+        al.syncthreads()
+
+        # Tree reduction
+        if tid < 128:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 64:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 64]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 64]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 32:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 16:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 8:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 4:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 2:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 2]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 2]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 1:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 1]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 1]
+
+        if tid == 0:
+            layout_ps = al.make_layout((batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))
+            ps = al.make_tensor(partial_sum_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
+            psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
+            ps[bid_y, tile_idx] = smem_sum[0]
+            psq[bid_y, tile_idx] = smem_sq[0]
+
+
+@avelang.jit
+def groupnorm_aggregate_kernel(
+    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
+    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
+    mean_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
+    rstd_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
+    batch_size: al.u32,
+    num_tiles: al.u32,
+    eps: al.f32,
+):
+    """
+    Phase 2: aggregate partial tile results into per-(batch, group) mean and rstd.
+    Grid: (batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, 1, 1), Block: (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1)
+    """
+    tid = al.thread_id(0)
+    bid = al.block_id(0)
+
+    total_pairs = batch_size * NUM_GROUPS
+    if bid < total_pairs:
+        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
+        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
+
+        layout_ps = al.make_layout((total_pairs, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))
+        ps = al.make_tensor(partial_sum_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
+        psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
+
+        local_sum = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
+        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
+
+        for t in al.range(tid, num_tiles, GN_BLOCK_SIZE):
+            local_sum = local_sum + ps[bid, t]
+            local_sq = local_sq + psq[bid, t]
+
+        smem_sum[tid] = local_sum
+        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
+        al.syncthreads()
+
+        if tid < 128:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 64:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 64]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 64]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 32:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 16:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 8:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
+        al.syncthreads()
+        if tid < 4:
+            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
+            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
+        al.syncthreads()

import avelang
import avelang.language as al

# ── ConvTranspose2d tiling constants ──────────────────────────────────────────
TILE_H = 16
TILE_W = 16
C_OUT_TILE = 8
C_IN_TILE = 8
C_TOTAL = 64
KERNEL = 3
THREADS_CONV = 256
IN_H = 256
IN_W = 256
OUT_H = IN_H + KERNEL - 1  # 258
OUT_W = IN_W + KERNEL - 1  # 258

SPATIAL_TILES_H = (OUT_H + TILE_H - 1) // TILE_H  # 17
SPATIAL_TILES_W = (OUT_W + TILE_W - 1) // TILE_W  # 17
SPATIAL_TILES = SPATIAL_TILES_H * SPATIAL_TILES_W  # 289
C_OUT_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_OUT_TILE  # 8
C_IN_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_IN_TILE  # 8

IN_TILE_H = TILE_H + PAD  # 18
IN_TILE_W = TILE_W + PAD  # 18
IN_TILE_ELEMS = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE  # 2592
WT_ELEMS = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL  # 576

BF16_BYTES = 2

# ── GroupNorm constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NUM_GROUPS = 8
C_PER_GROUP = C_TOTAL // NUM_GROUPS  # 8
GN_N = C_PER_GROUP * OUT_H * OUT_W  # 8 * 258 * 258 = 532512
GN_BLOCK_SIZE = 256
GN_TILE_SIZE = 4096

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ConvTranspose2d + GELU fused kernel
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@avelang.jit
def _load_input_to_shm(
    shm_in: al.Tensor((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16),
    x_rsrc: al.Tensor((4,), al.u32),
    n: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tile_h_start: al.u32,
    tile_w_start: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    zero = al.convert(0, al.u32)
    total = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE
    idx = tid
    for _ in al.range((total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV):
        if idx < total:
            c = idx % C_IN_TILE
            s = idx // C_IN_TILE
            ih = s // IN_TILE_W
            iw = s - ih * IN_TILE_W
            src_h = tile_h_start + ih - PAD
            src_w = tile_w_start + iw - PAD
            valid = al.convert(1, al.u32)
            if src_h >= IN_H:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if src_w >= IN_W:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            off = (n * C_TOTAL * IN_H * IN_W + (cin_base + c) * IN_H * IN_W + src_h * IN_W + src_w) * BF16_BYTES
            val_u32 = al.amdgpu.raw_buffer_load_x1(x_rsrc, zero, off, 0)
            if valid != 0:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.bitcast(val_u32, al.bf16)
            else:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.convert(0.0, al.bf16)
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def _load_weight_to_shm(
    shm_wt: al.Tensor((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16),
    wt_rsrc: al.Tensor((4,), al.u32),
    cout_base: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    zero = al.convert(0, al.u32)
    total = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
    idx = tid
    for _ in al.range((total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV):
        if idx < total:
            cout_idx = idx // (C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest = idx - cout_idx * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
            cin_idx = rest // (KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest2 = rest - cin_idx * KERNEL * KERNEL
            kh = rest2 // KERNEL
            kw = rest2 - kh * KERNEL
            # weight layout: (in_channels, out_channels, K, K) = (C_TOTAL, C_TOTAL, 3, 3)
            # weight[cin_global, cout_global, kh, kw]
            cin_global = cin_base + cin_idx
            cout_global = cout_base + cout_idx
            off = (cin_global * C_TOTAL * KERNEL * KERNEL + cout_global * KERNEL * KERNEL + kh * KERNEL + kw) * BF16_BYTES

    bid_y = al.block_id(1)   # batch * c_out_tile index

    tile_w_start = tile_w_idx * TILE_W

    bias_memref = al.make_tensor(bias_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((C_TOTAL,), (1,)))

def groupnorm_aggregate_kernel(
    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    mean_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    rstd_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
    eps: al.f32,
):
    """
    Phase 2: aggregate partial tile results into per-(batch, group) mean and rstd.
    Grid: (batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, 1, 1), Block: (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1)
    """
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid = al.block_id(0)

    total_pairs = batch_size * NUM_GROUPS
    if bid < total_pairs:
        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)

        layout_ps = al.make_layout((total_pairs, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))

        psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)

        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

            local_sum = local_sum + ps[bid, t]
            local_sq = local_sq + psq[bid, t]

        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
        al.syncthreads()

        if tid < 128:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
        al.syncthreads()

        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 32:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 16:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 8:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 4:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 2:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 2]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 2]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 1:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 1]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 1]

            N_f32 = al.convert(GN_N, al.f32)
            total_sum = smem_sum[0]
            total_sq = smem_sq[0]

            var = total_sq / N_f32 - mean * mean

def groupnorm_apply_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    weight_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    mean_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    rstd_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
):
    """
    Phase 3: apply normalization and affine transform.
    Grid: (num_tiles, batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, 1), Block: (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1)
    """
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)

def _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if t.is_cuda and t.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and t.is_contiguous():
        return t
    if t.is_cuda:
        return t.contiguous().to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    return t.contiguous().cuda().to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)


def avelang_conv_transpose_gelu_groupnorm(
    x: torch.Tensor,
    conv_weight: torch.Tensor,
    conv_bias: torch.Tensor,
    gn_weight: torch.Tensor,
    gn_bias: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert x.is_cuda, "Input must be on CUDA/HIP device."
    x_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(x)
    wt_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(conv_weight)
    bias_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(conv_bias)
    gn_wt_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(gn_weight)
    gn_bias_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(gn_bias)

    batch_size = x_bf16.shape[0]
    assert batch_size == 128, f"Expected batch_size=128, got {batch_size}"

    # Phase 1: ConvTranspose2d + GELU → intermediate tensor
    intermediate = torch.empty(
        (batch_size, C_TOTAL, OUT_H, OUT_W),
        device=x_bf16.device,
        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    )

    grid_conv = (SPATIAL_TILES, batch_size * C_OUT_TILES, 1)
    conv_transpose_gelu_kernel[lambda: (grid_conv, (THREADS_CONV, 1, 1))](
        x_bf16, wt_bf16, bias_bf16, intermediate, batch_size
    )

    # Phase 2: GroupNorm (3 sub-phases)
    total_pairs = batch_size * NUM_GROUPS

    # 2a: reduce
    partial_sum = torch.empty((total_pairs, GN_NUM_TILES), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)
    partial_sq = torch.empty((total_pairs, GN_NUM_TILES), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)

    grid_reduce = (GN_NUM_TILES, total_pairs, 1)
    groupnorm_reduce_kernel[lambda: (grid_reduce, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        intermediate, partial_sum, partial_sq, batch_size, GN_NUM_TILES
    )

    # 2b: aggregate
    mean_out = torch.empty((total_pairs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)
    rstd_out = torch.empty((total_pairs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)

    eps = 1e-5
    grid_agg = (total_pairs, 1, 1)
    groupnorm_aggregate_kernel[lambda: (grid_agg, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        partial_sum, partial_sq, mean_out, rstd_out, batch_size, GN_NUM_TILES, eps
    )

    # 2c: apply
    out_bf16 = torch.empty_like(intermediate)

    grid_apply = (GN_NUM_TILES, total_pairs, 1)
    groupnorm_apply_kernel[lambda: (grid_apply, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        intermediate, gn_wt_bf16, gn_bias_bf16, out_bf16, mean_out, rstd_out, batch_size, GN_NUM_TILES
    )

    return out_bf16

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, groups, num_groups):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        self.conv_transpose = nn.ConvTranspose2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride)

            self.conv_transpose.bias,
            self.group_norm.weight,
            self.group_norm.bias,
        )
        return result_bf16.to(torch.float32)

IN_TILE_H = TILE_H + PAD  # 18
IN_TILE_W = TILE_W + PAD  # 18

# ── GroupNorm constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NUM_GROUPS = 8
C_PER_GROUP = C_TOTAL // NUM_GROUPS  # 8
GN_N = C_PER_GROUP * OUT_H * OUT_W  # 8 * 258 * 258 = 532512
GN_BLOCK_SIZE = 256
GN_TILE_SIZE = 4096
GN_NUM_TILES = (GN_N + GN_TILE_SIZE - 1) // GN_TILE_SIZE  # 131


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ConvTranspose2d + GELU fused kernel
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@avelang.jit
def _load_input_to_shm(
    shm_in: al.Tensor((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16),
    x_tensor: al.Tensor((128, 64, 256, 256), al.bf16),
    n: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tile_h_start: al.u32,
    tile_w_start: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    total = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE
    idx = tid
    iters = (total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    for _ in al.range(iters):
        if idx < total:
            c = idx % C_IN_TILE
            s = idx // C_IN_TILE
            ih = s // IN_TILE_W
            iw = s - ih * IN_TILE_W
            src_h = tile_h_start + ih - PAD
            src_w = tile_w_start + iw - PAD
            valid = al.convert(1, al.u32)
            if src_h >= IN_H:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if src_w >= IN_W:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if valid != 0:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = x_tensor[n, cin_base + c, src_h, src_w]
            else:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.convert(0.0, al.bf16)
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def _load_weight_to_shm(
    shm_wt: al.Tensor((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16),
    wt_tensor: al.Tensor((64, 64, 3, 3), al.bf16),
    cout_base: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    total = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
    idx = tid
    iters = (total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    for _ in al.range(iters):
        if idx < total:
            cout_idx = idx // (C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest = idx - cout_idx * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
            cin_idx = rest // (KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest2 = rest - cin_idx * KERNEL * KERNEL
            kh = rest2 // KERNEL
            kw = rest2 - kh * KERNEL
            cin_global = cin_base + cin_idx
            cout_global = cout_base + cout_idx
            shm_wt[cout_idx, cin_idx, kh, kw] = wt_tensor[cin_global, cout_global, kh, kw]
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def conv_transpose_gelu_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    wt_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    batch_size: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)   # spatial tile index
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)   # batch * c_out_tile index

    n = bid_y // C_OUT_TILES
    cout_tile = bid_y - n * C_OUT_TILES
    cout_base = cout_tile * C_OUT_TILE

    tile_h_idx = bid_x // SPATIAL_TILES_W
    tile_w_idx = bid_x - tile_h_idx * SPATIAL_TILES_W
    tile_h_start = tile_h_idx * TILE_H
    tile_w_start = tile_w_idx * TILE_W

    # Tensor views via flat layout + view cast
    x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 256 * 256,), (1,)))
    x_view = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 256, 256), al.bf16))
    wt_flat = al.make_tensor(wt_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64 * 64 * 3 * 3,), (1,)))
    wt_view = al.view(wt_flat, al.Tensor((64, 64, 3, 3), al.bf16))
    bias_flat = al.make_tensor(bias_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64,), (1,)))
    bias_view = al.view(bias_flat, al.Tensor((64,), al.bf16))
    out_flat = al.make_tensor(out_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
    out_view = al.view(out_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

    shm_in = al.make_shared((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16)
    shm_wt = al.make_shared((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16)

    # Accumulators: one f32 per output position assigned to this thread
    ACC_PER_THREAD = (TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    acc = al.make_local((ACC_PER_THREAD,), al.f32)
    for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
        acc[i] = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

    # Iterate over input channel tiles
    for cin_tile in al.range(C_IN_TILES):
        cin_base = cin_tile * C_IN_TILE
        _load_input_to_shm(shm_in, x_view, n, cin_base, tile_h_start, tile_w_start, tid)
        _load_weight_to_shm(shm_wt, wt_view, cout_base, cin_base, tid)
        al.syncthreads()

        # Each thread computes its assigned output elements
        for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
            idx = tid * ACC_PER_THREAD + i
            if idx < TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE:
                local_cout = idx % C_OUT_TILE
                s = idx // C_OUT_TILE
                local_h = s // TILE_W
                local_w = s - local_h * TILE_W

                sum_val = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
                for cin_idx in al.range(C_IN_TILE):
                    for kh in al.range(KERNEL):
                        for kw in al.range(KERNEL):
                            in_h = local_h + PAD - kh
                            in_w = local_w + PAD - kw
                            in_val = al.convert(shm_in[in_h, in_w, cin_idx], al.f32)
                            wt_val = al.convert(shm_wt[local_cout, cin_idx, kh, kw], al.f32)
                            sum_val = sum_val + in_val * wt_val
                acc[i] = acc[i] + sum_val

        al.syncthreads()

    # Apply bias, GELU, and write output
    sqrt_two_over_pi = al.convert(0.7978845608028654, al.f32)
    gelu_coeff = al.convert(0.044715, al.f32)
    half = al.convert(0.5, al.f32)
    one = al.convert(1.0, al.f32)

    for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
        idx = tid * ACC_PER_THREAD + i
        if idx < TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE:
            local_cout = idx % C_OUT_TILE
            s = idx // C_OUT_TILE
            local_h = s // TILE_W
            local_w = s - local_h * TILE_W

            global_h = tile_h_start + local_h
            global_w = tile_w_start + local_w
            global_cout = cout_base + local_cout

            if global_h < OUT_H and global_w < OUT_W:
                val = acc[i]
                # Add bias
                b = al.convert(bias_view[global_cout], al.f32)
                val = val + b
                # GELU: 0.5 * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(2/pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x^3)))
                x3 = val * val * val
                inner = sqrt_two_over_pi * (val + gelu_coeff * x3)
                gelu_out = half * val * (one + al.tanh(inner))
                out_view[n, global_cout, global_h, global_w] = al.convert(gelu_out, al.bf16)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GroupNorm multi-pass kernels
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@avelang.jit
def groupnorm_reduce_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)

    batch_idx = bid_y // NUM_GROUPS
    group_idx = bid_y - batch_idx * NUM_GROUPS
    tile_idx = bid_x

    if batch_idx < batch_size:
        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)

        group_c_start = group_idx * C_PER_GROUP

        tile_start = tile_idx * GN_TILE_SIZE
        tile_end = tile_start + GN_TILE_SIZE
        if tile_end > GN_N:
            tile_end = GN_N

        x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
        x = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

        local_sum = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

        for li in al.range(tile_start + tid, tile_end, GN_BLOCK_SIZE):
            c_g = li // (OUT_H * OUT_W)
            rest = li - c_g * OUT_H * OUT_W
            h = rest // OUT_W
            w = rest - h * OUT_W
            global_c = group_c_start + c_g
            val = al.convert(x[batch_idx, global_c, h, w], al.f32)
            local_sum = local_sum + val
            local_sq = local_sq + val * val

        smem_sum[tid] = local_sum
        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
        al.syncthreads()

        if tid < 128:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 64:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 64]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 64]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 32:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 16:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 8:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 4:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 2:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 2]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 2]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 1:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 1]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 1]

        if tid == 0:
            layout_ps = al.make_layout((batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))
            ps = al.make_tensor(partial_sum_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
            psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
            ps[bid_y, tile_idx] = smem_sum[0]
            psq[bid_y, tile_idx] = smem_sq[0]


@avelang.jit
def groupnorm_aggregate_kernel(
    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    mean_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    rstd_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
    eps: al.f32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid = al.block_id(0)

    total_pairs = batch_size * NUM_GROUPS
    if bid < total_pairs:
        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)

        layout_ps = al.make_layout((total_pairs, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))
        ps = al.make_tensor(partial_sum_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
        psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)

        local_sum = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

        t = tid
        iters = (num_tiles + GN_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // GN_BLOCK_SIZE
        for _ in al.range(iters):
            if t < num_tiles:
                local_sum = local_sum + ps[bid, t]
                local_sq = local_sq + psq[bid, t]
            t = t + GN_BLOCK_SIZE

        smem_sum[tid] = local_sum
        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
        al.syncthreads()

        if tid < 128:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 64:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 64]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 64]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 32:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 16:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 8:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 4:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 2:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 2]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 2]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 1:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 1]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 1]

        if tid == 0:
            N_f32 = al.convert(GN_N, al.f32)
            total_sum = smem_sum[0]
            total_sq = smem_sq[0]
            mean = total_sum / N_f32
            var = total_sq / N_f32 - mean * mean
            rstd = al.convert(1.0, al.f32) / al.sqrt(var + eps)

            layout_out = al.make_layout((total_pairs,), (1,))
            mo = al.make_tensor(mean_out_ptr, al.f32, layout_out)
            ro = al.make_tensor(rstd_out_ptr, al.f32, layout_out)
            mo[bid] = mean
            ro[bid] = rstd


@avelang.jit
def groupnorm_apply_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    weight_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    mean_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    rstd_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)

    batch_idx = bid_y // NUM_GROUPS
    group_idx = bid_y - batch_idx * NUM_GROUPS
    tile_idx = bid_x

    if batch_idx < batch_size:
        group_c_start = group_idx * C_PER_GROUP

        tile_start = tile_idx * GN_TILE_SIZE
        tile_end = tile_start + GN_TILE_SIZE
        if tile_end > GN_N:
            tile_end = GN_N

        x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
        x = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

        wt_flat = al.make_tensor(weight_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64,), (1,)))
        wt = al.view(wt_flat, al.Tensor((64,), al.bf16))
        bt_flat = al.make_tensor(bias_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64,), (1,)))
        bt = al.view(bt_flat, al.Tensor((64,), al.bf16))

        out_flat = al.make_tensor(out_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
        ot = al.view(out_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

        layout_stat = al.make_layout((batch_size * NUM_GROUPS,), (1,))
        mt = al.make_tensor(mean_ptr, al.f32, layout_stat)
        rt = al.make_tensor(rstd_ptr, al.f32, layout_stat)

        mean = mt[bid_y]
        rstd = rt[bid_y]

        for li in al.range(tile_start + tid, tile_end, GN_BLOCK_SIZE):
            c_g = li // (OUT_H * OUT_W)
            rest = li - c_g * OUT_H * OUT_W
            h = rest // OUT_W
            w = rest - h * OUT_W
            global_c = group_c_start + c_g

            x_val = al.convert(x[batch_idx, global_c, h, w], al.f32)
            w_val = al.convert(wt[global_c], al.f32)
            b_val = al.convert(bt[global_c], al.f32)

            normalized = (x_val - mean) * rstd
            result = normalized * w_val + b_val
            ot[batch_idx, global_c, h, w] = al.convert(result, al.bf16)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Host wrapper
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if t.is_cuda and t.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and t.is_contiguous():
        return t
    if t.is_cuda:
        return t.contiguous().to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    return t.contiguous().cuda().to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)


def avelang_conv_transpose_gelu_groupnorm(
    x: torch.Tensor,
    conv_weight: torch.Tensor,
    conv_bias: torch.Tensor,
    gn_weight: torch.Tensor,
    gn_bias: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert x.is_cuda, "Input must be on CUDA/HIP device."
    x_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(x)
    wt_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(conv_weight)
    bias_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(conv_bias)
    gn_wt_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(gn_weight)
    gn_bias_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(gn_bias)

    batch_size_val = x_bf16.shape[0]
    assert batch_size_val == 128, f"Expected batch_size=128, got {batch_size_val}"

    # Phase 1: ConvTranspose2d + GELU → intermediate tensor
    intermediate = torch.empty(
        (128, C_TOTAL, OUT_H, OUT_W),
        device=x_bf16.device,
        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    )

    grid_conv = (SPATIAL_TILES, batch_size_val * C_OUT_TILES, 1)
    conv_transpose_gelu_kernel[lambda: (grid_conv, (THREADS_CONV, 1, 1))](
        x_bf16, wt_bf16, bias_bf16, intermediate, batch_size_val
    )

    # Phase 2: GroupNorm (3 sub-phases)
    total_pairs = batch_size_val * NUM_GROUPS

    # 2a: reduce
    partial_sum = torch.empty((total_pairs, GN_NUM_TILES), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)
    partial_sq = torch.empty((total_pairs, GN_NUM_TILES), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)

    grid_reduce = (GN_NUM_TILES, total_pairs, 1)
    groupnorm_reduce_kernel[lambda: (grid_reduce, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        intermediate, partial_sum, partial_sq, batch_size_val, GN_NUM_TILES
    )

    # 2b: aggregate
    mean_out = torch.empty((total_pairs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)
    rstd_out = torch.empty((total_pairs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)

    eps = 1e-5
    grid_agg = (total_pairs, 1, 1)
    groupnorm_aggregate_kernel[lambda: (grid_agg, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        partial_sum, partial_sq, mean_out, rstd_out, batch_size_val, GN_NUM_TILES, eps
    )

    # 2c: apply
    out_bf16 = torch.empty_like(intermediate)

    grid_apply = (GN_NUM_TILES, total_pairs, 1)
    groupnorm_apply_kernel[lambda: (grid_apply, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        intermediate, gn_wt_bf16, gn_bias_bf16, out_bf16, mean_out, rstd_out, batch_size_val, GN_NUM_TILES
    )

    return out_bf16


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ModelNew - matches the input_model.py contract
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, groups, num_groups):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        self.conv_transpose = nn.ConvTranspose2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride)
        self.group_norm = nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=num_groups, num_channels=out_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        result_bf16 = avelang_conv_transpose_gelu_groupnorm(
            x,
            self.conv_transpose.weight,
            self.conv_transpose.bias,
            self.group_norm.weight,
            self.group_norm.bias,
        )
        return result_bf16.to(torch.float32)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import math
import avelang
import avelang.language as al

# ── ConvTranspose2d tiling constants ──────────────────────────────────────────
TILE_H = 16
TILE_W = 16
C_OUT_TILE = 8
C_IN_TILE = 8
C_TOTAL = 64
KERNEL = 3
THREADS_CONV = 256
IN_H = 256
IN_W = 256
OUT_H = IN_H + KERNEL - 1  # 258
OUT_W = IN_W + KERNEL - 1  # 258

SPATIAL_TILES_H = (OUT_H + TILE_H - 1) // TILE_H  # 17
SPATIAL_TILES_W = (OUT_W + TILE_W - 1) // TILE_W  # 17
SPATIAL_TILES = SPATIAL_TILES_H * SPATIAL_TILES_W  # 289
C_OUT_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_OUT_TILE  # 8
C_IN_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_IN_TILE  # 8

PAD = KERNEL - 1  # 2
IN_TILE_H = TILE_H + PAD  # 18
IN_TILE_W = TILE_W + PAD  # 18

# ── GroupNorm constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NUM_GROUPS = 8
C_PER_GROUP = C_TOTAL // NUM_GROUPS  # 8
GN_N = C_PER_GROUP * OUT_H * OUT_W  # 8 * 258 * 258 = 532512
GN_BLOCK_SIZE = 256
GN_TILE_SIZE = 4096
GN_NUM_TILES = (GN_N + GN_TILE_SIZE - 1) // GN_TILE_SIZE  # 131


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ConvTranspose2d + GELU fused kernel
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@avelang.jit
def _load_input_to_shm(
    shm_in: al.Tensor((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16),
    x_tensor: al.Tensor((128, 64, 256, 256), al.bf16),
    n: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tile_h_start: al.u32,
    tile_w_start: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    total = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE
    idx = tid
    iters = (total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    for _ in al.range(iters):
        if idx < total:
            c = idx % C_IN_TILE
            s = idx // C_IN_TILE
            ih = s // IN_TILE_W
            iw = s - ih * IN_TILE_W
            src_h = tile_h_start + ih - PAD
            src_w = tile_w_start + iw - PAD
            valid = al.convert(1, al.u32)
            if src_h >= IN_H:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if src_w >= IN_W:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if valid != 0:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = x_tensor[n, cin_base + c, src_h, src_w]
            else:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.convert(0.0, al.bf16)
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def _load_weight_to_shm(
    shm_wt: al.Tensor((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16),
    wt_tensor: al.Tensor((64, 64, 3, 3), al.bf16),
    cout_base: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    total = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
    idx = tid
    iters = (total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    for _ in al.range(iters):
        if idx < total:
            cout_idx = idx // (C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest = idx - cout_idx * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
            cin_idx = rest // (KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest2 = rest - cin_idx * KERNEL * KERNEL
            kh = rest2 // KERNEL
            kw = rest2 - kh * KERNEL
            cin_global = cin_base + cin_idx
            cout_global = cout_base + cout_idx
            shm_wt[cout_idx, cin_idx, kh, kw] = wt_tensor[cin_global, cout_global, kh, kw]
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def conv_transpose_gelu_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    wt_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    batch_size: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)   # spatial tile index
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)   # batch * c_out_tile index

    n = bid_y // C_OUT_TILES
    cout_tile = bid_y - n * C_OUT_TILES
    cout_base = cout_tile * C_OUT_TILE

    tile_h_idx = bid_x // SPATIAL_TILES_W
    tile_w_idx = bid_x - tile_h_idx * SPATIAL_TILES_W
    tile_h_start = tile_h_idx * TILE_H
    tile_w_start = tile_w_idx * TILE_W

    # Tensor views via flat layout + view cast
    x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 256 * 256,), (1,)))
    x_view = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 256, 256), al.bf16))
    wt_flat = al.make_tensor(wt_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64 * 64 * 3 * 3,), (1,)))
    wt_view = al.view(wt_flat, al.Tensor((64, 64, 3, 3), al.bf16))
    bias_flat = al.make_tensor(bias_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64,), (1,)))
    bias_view = al.view(bias_flat, al.Tensor((64,), al.bf16))
    out_flat = al.make_tensor(out_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
    out_view = al.view(out_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

    shm_in = al.make_shared((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16)
    shm_wt = al.make_shared((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16)

    # Accumulators: one f32 per output position assigned to this thread
    ACC_PER_THREAD = (TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    acc = al.make_local((ACC_PER_THREAD,), al.f32)
    for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
        acc[i] = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

    # Iterate over input channel tiles
    for cin_tile in al.range(C_IN_TILES):
        cin_base = cin_tile * C_IN_TILE
        _load_input_to_shm(shm_in, x_view, n, cin_base, tile_h_start, tile_w_start, tid)
        _load_weight_to_shm(shm_wt, wt_view, cout_base, cin_base, tid)
        al.syncthreads()

        # Each thread computes its assigned output elements
        for i in al.range(ACC_PER_THREAD):
            idx = tid * ACC_PER_THREAD + i
            if idx < TILE_H * TILE_W * C_OUT_TILE:
                local_cout = idx % C_OUT_TILE
                s = idx // C_OUT_TILE
                local_h = s // TILE_W
                local_w = s - local_h * TILE_W

                sum_val = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
                for cin_idx in al.range(C_IN_TILE):
                    for kh in al.range(KERNEL):
                        for kw in al.range(KERNEL):
                            in_h = local_h + PAD - kh
                            in_w = local_w + PAD - kw

                sum_val = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
                for cin_idx in al.range(C_IN_TILE):

@avelang.jit
def groupnorm_reduce_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)

    batch_idx = bid_y // NUM_GROUPS
    group_idx = bid_y - batch_idx * NUM_GROUPS
    tile_idx = bid_x

    if batch_idx < batch_size:
        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)

        group_c_start = group_idx * C_PER_GROUP

        tile_start = tile_idx * GN_TILE_SIZE
        tile_end = tile_start + GN_TILE_SIZE
        if tile_end > GN_N:
            tile_end = GN_N

        x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
        x = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

        local_sum = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

        for li in al.range(tile_start + tid, tile_end, GN_BLOCK_SIZE):
            c_g = li // (OUT_H * OUT_W)
            rest = li - c_g * OUT_H * OUT_W
            h = rest // OUT_W
            w = rest - h * OUT_W
            global_c = group_c_start + c_g
            val = al.convert(x[batch_idx, global_c, h, w], al.f32)
            local_sum = local_sum + val
            local_sq = local_sq + val * val

        smem_sum[tid] = local_sum
        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
        al.syncthreads()

        if tid < 128:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 64:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 64]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 64]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 32:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 16:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 8:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 4:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 2:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 2]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 2]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 1:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 1]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 1]

        if tid == 0:
            layout_ps = al.make_layout((batch_size * NUM_GROUPS, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))
            ps = al.make_tensor(partial_sum_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
            psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
            ps[bid_y, tile_idx] = smem_sum[0]
            psq[bid_y, tile_idx] = smem_sq[0]


@avelang.jit
def groupnorm_aggregate_kernel(
    partial_sum_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    partial_sq_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    mean_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    rstd_out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
    eps: al.f32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid = al.block_id(0)

    total_pairs = batch_size * NUM_GROUPS
    if bid < total_pairs:
        smem_sum = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)
        smem_sq = al.make_shared((GN_BLOCK_SIZE,), al.f32)

        layout_ps = al.make_layout((total_pairs, num_tiles), (num_tiles, 1))
        ps = al.make_tensor(partial_sum_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)
        psq = al.make_tensor(partial_sq_ptr, al.f32, layout_ps)

        local_sum = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)
        local_sq = al.convert(0.0, al.f32)

        t = tid
        iters = (num_tiles + GN_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // GN_BLOCK_SIZE
        for _ in al.range(iters):
            if t < num_tiles:
                local_sum = local_sum + ps[bid, t]
                local_sq = local_sq + psq[bid, t]
            t = t + GN_BLOCK_SIZE

        smem_sum[tid] = local_sum
        smem_sq[tid] = local_sq
        al.syncthreads()

        if tid < 128:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 128]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 128]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 64:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 64]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 64]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 32:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 32]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 32]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 16:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 16]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 16]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 8:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 8]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 8]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 4:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 4]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 4]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 2:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 2]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 2]
        al.syncthreads()
        if tid < 1:
            smem_sum[tid] = smem_sum[tid] + smem_sum[tid + 1]
            smem_sq[tid] = smem_sq[tid] + smem_sq[tid + 1]

        if tid == 0:
            N_f32 = al.convert(GN_N, al.f32)
            total_sum = smem_sum[0]
            total_sq = smem_sq[0]
            mean = total_sum / N_f32
            var = total_sq / N_f32 - mean * mean
            rstd = al.convert(1.0, al.f32) / al.sqrt(var + eps)

            layout_out = al.make_layout((total_pairs,), (1,))
            mo = al.make_tensor(mean_out_ptr, al.f32, layout_out)
            ro = al.make_tensor(rstd_out_ptr, al.f32, layout_out)
            mo[bid] = mean
            ro[bid] = rstd


@avelang.jit
def groupnorm_apply_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    weight_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    mean_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    rstd_ptr: al.Pointer(al.f32),
    batch_size: al.u32,
    num_tiles: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)

    batch_idx = bid_y // NUM_GROUPS
    group_idx = bid_y - batch_idx * NUM_GROUPS
    tile_idx = bid_x

    if batch_idx < batch_size:
        group_c_start = group_idx * C_PER_GROUP

        tile_start = tile_idx * GN_TILE_SIZE
        tile_end = tile_start + GN_TILE_SIZE
        if tile_end > GN_N:
            tile_end = GN_N

        x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
        x = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

        wt_flat = al.make_tensor(weight_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64,), (1,)))
        wt = al.view(wt_flat, al.Tensor((64,), al.bf16))
        bt_flat = al.make_tensor(bias_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((64,), (1,)))
        bt = al.view(bt_flat, al.Tensor((64,), al.bf16))

        out_flat = al.make_tensor(out_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 258 * 258,), (1,)))
        ot = al.view(out_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 258, 258), al.bf16))

        layout_stat = al.make_layout((batch_size * NUM_GROUPS,), (1,))
        mt = al.make_tensor(mean_ptr, al.f32, layout_stat)
        rt = al.make_tensor(rstd_ptr, al.f32, layout_stat)

        mean = mt[bid_y]
        rstd = rt[bid_y]

        for li in al.range(tile_start + tid, tile_end, GN_BLOCK_SIZE):
            c_g = li // (OUT_H * OUT_W)
            rest = li - c_g * OUT_H * OUT_W
            h = rest // OUT_W
            w = rest - h * OUT_W
            global_c = group_c_start + c_g

            x_val = al.convert(x[batch_idx, global_c, h, w], al.f32)
            w_val = al.convert(wt[global_c], al.f32)
            b_val = al.convert(bt[global_c], al.f32)

            normalized = (x_val - mean) * rstd
            result = normalized * w_val + b_val
            ot[batch_idx, global_c, h, w] = al.convert(result, al.bf16)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Host wrapper
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if t.is_cuda and t.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and t.is_contiguous():
        return t
    if t.is_cuda:
        return t.contiguous().to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    return t.contiguous().cuda().to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)


def avelang_conv_transpose_gelu_groupnorm(
    x: torch.Tensor,
    conv_weight: torch.Tensor,
    conv_bias: torch.Tensor,
    gn_weight: torch.Tensor,
    gn_bias: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert x.is_cuda, "Input must be on CUDA/HIP device."
    x_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(x)
    wt_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(conv_weight)
    bias_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(conv_bias)
    gn_wt_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(gn_weight)
    gn_bias_bf16 = _prepare_bf16_cuda_contiguous(gn_bias)

    batch_size_val = x_bf16.shape[0]

    intermediate = torch.empty(
        (batch_size_val, C_TOTAL, OUT_H, OUT_W),
        device=x_bf16.device,
        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    )

    grid_conv = (SPATIAL_TILES, batch_size_val * C_OUT_TILES, 1)
    conv_transpose_gelu_kernel[lambda: (grid_conv, (THREADS_CONV, 1, 1))](
        x_bf16, wt_bf16, bias_bf16, intermediate, batch_size_val
    )

    total_pairs = batch_size_val * NUM_GROUPS

    partial_sum = torch.empty((total_pairs, GN_NUM_TILES), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)
    partial_sq = torch.empty((total_pairs, GN_NUM_TILES), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)

    grid_reduce = (GN_NUM_TILES, total_pairs, 1)
    groupnorm_reduce_kernel[lambda: (grid_reduce, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        intermediate, partial_sum, partial_sq, batch_size_val, GN_NUM_TILES
    )

    mean_out = torch.empty((total_pairs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)
    rstd_out = torch.empty((total_pairs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x_bf16.device)

    eps = 1e-5
    grid_agg = (total_pairs, 1, 1)
    groupnorm_aggregate_kernel[lambda: (grid_agg, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        partial_sum, partial_sq, mean_out, rstd_out, batch_size_val, GN_NUM_TILES, eps
    )

    out_bf16 = torch.empty_like(intermediate)

    grid_apply = (GN_NUM_TILES, total_pairs, 1)
    groupnorm_apply_kernel[lambda: (grid_apply, (GN_BLOCK_SIZE, 1, 1))](
        intermediate, gn_wt_bf16, gn_bias_bf16, out_bf16, mean_out, rstd_out, batch_size_val, GN_NUM_TILES
    )

    return out_bf16

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, groups, num_groups):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        self.conv_transpose = nn.ConvTranspose2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride)
        self.group_norm = nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=num_groups, num_channels=out_channels)

            self.conv_transpose.weight,
            self.conv_transpose.bias,
            self.group_norm.weight,
            self.group_norm.bias,
        )
        # Match reference output dtype (float32)
        return result_bf16.to(torch.float32)

def _process_input_tensor(input, device, backend="cuda", precision=torch.float32):
    """
    Helper function to move tensors to the correct device and apply backend-specific dtype casting.
    
    Args:
        input: Input tensor or non-tensor value
        device: Target CUDA device
        backend: Backend type (e.g., 'cuda', 'triton', 'cute')
        precision: torch.dtype 
    Returns:
        Processed tensor on correct device with correct dtype, or original value if not a tensor
    """

    # sometimes things like init inputs are floats (like in the case of labels / targets, classification losses, etc.) 
    if not isinstance(input, torch.Tensor):
        return input
    
    # cast to the desired percision dtype for activations
    input_tensor = input.to(dtype=precision)
    
    # Default for all other backends and float types
    return input_tensor.to(device=device)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import math
import avelang
import avelang.language as al

# ── ConvTranspose2d tiling constants ──────────────────────────────────────────
TILE_H = 16
TILE_W = 16
C_OUT_TILE = 8
C_IN_TILE = 8
C_TOTAL = 64
KERNEL = 3
THREADS_CONV = 256
IN_H = 256
IN_W = 256
OUT_H = IN_H + KERNEL - 1
OUT_W = IN_W + KERNEL - 1

SPATIAL_TILES_H = (OUT_H + TILE_H - 1) // TILE_H
SPATIAL_TILES_W = (OUT_W + TILE_W - 1) // TILE_W
SPATIAL_TILES = SPATIAL_TILES_H * SPATIAL_TILES_W
C_OUT_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_OUT_TILE
C_IN_TILES = C_TOTAL // C_IN_TILE

PAD = KERNEL - 1
IN_TILE_H = TILE_H + PAD
IN_TILE_W = TILE_W + PAD

# ── GroupNorm constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NUM_GROUPS = 8
C_PER_GROUP = C_TOTAL // NUM_GROUPS
GN_N = C_PER_GROUP * OUT_H * OUT_W
GN_BLOCK_SIZE = 256
GN_TILE_SIZE = 4096
GN_NUM_TILES = (GN_N + GN_TILE_SIZE - 1) // GN_TILE_SIZE


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ConvTranspose2d + GELU fused kernel
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@avelang.jit
def _load_input_to_shm(
    shm_in: al.Tensor((IN_TILE_H, IN_TILE_W, C_IN_TILE), al.bf16),
    x_tensor: al.Tensor((128, 64, 256, 256), al.bf16),
    n: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tile_h_start: al.u32,
    tile_w_start: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    total = IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W * C_IN_TILE
    idx = tid
    iters = (total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    for _ in al.range(iters):
        if idx < total:
            c = idx % C_IN_TILE
            s = idx // C_IN_TILE
            ih = s // IN_TILE_W
            iw = s - ih * IN_TILE_W
            src_h = tile_h_start + ih - PAD
            src_w = tile_w_start + iw - PAD
            valid = al.convert(1, al.u32)
            if src_h >= IN_H:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if src_w >= IN_W:
                valid = al.convert(0, al.u32)
            if valid != 0:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = x_tensor[n, cin_base + c, src_h, src_w]
            else:
                shm_in[ih, iw, c] = al.convert(0.0, al.bf16)
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def _load_weight_to_shm(
    shm_wt: al.Tensor((C_OUT_TILE, C_IN_TILE, KERNEL, KERNEL), al.bf16),
    wt_tensor: al.Tensor((64, 64, 3, 3), al.bf16),
    cout_base: al.u32,
    cin_base: al.u32,
    tid: al.u32,
):
    total = C_OUT_TILE * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
    idx = tid
    iters = (total + THREADS_CONV - 1) // THREADS_CONV
    for _ in al.range(iters):
        if idx < total:
            cout_idx = idx // (C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest = idx - cout_idx * C_IN_TILE * KERNEL * KERNEL
            cin_idx = rest // (KERNEL * KERNEL)
            rest2 = rest - cin_idx * KERNEL * KERNEL
            kh = rest2 // KERNEL
            kw = rest2 - kh * KERNEL
            cin_global = cin_base + cin_idx
            cout_global = cout_base + cout_idx
            shm_wt[cout_idx, cin_idx, kh, kw] = wt_tensor[cin_global, cout_global, kh, kw]
        idx = idx + THREADS_CONV


@avelang.jit
def conv_transpose_gelu_kernel(
    x_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    wt_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    bias_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    out_ptr: al.Pointer(al.bf16),
    batch_size: al.u32,
):
    tid = al.thread_id(0)
    bid_x = al.block_id(0)
    bid_y = al.block_id(1)

    n = bid_y // C_OUT_TILES
    cout_tile = bid_y - n * C_OUT_TILES
    cout_base = cout_tile * C_OUT_TILE

    tile_h_idx = bid_x // SPATIAL_TILES_W
    tile_w_idx = bid_x - tile_h_idx * SPATIAL_TILES_W
    tile_h_start = tile_h_idx * TILE_H
    tile_w_start = tile_w_idx * TILE_W

    x_flat = al.make_tensor(x_ptr, al.bf16, al.make_layout((128 * 64 * 256 * 256,), (1,)))
    x_view = al.view(x_flat, al.Tensor((128, 64, 256, 256), al.bf16))
